title: attachment size_bytes u64→i64 sign-flip on attacker-controlled input
description: attachment.rs::insert casts size_bytes: u64 to i64 via 'as'. Peer-supplied size >= 2^63 stores a negative value; on read it casts back to a huge u64 via 'as u64'. Architecture doc lists attachment size as 'attacker-controlled, trust nothing'. Fix: use i64::try_from(size_bytes).map_err(|_| KithError::Store("attachment too large")) and enforce maxAttachmentBytes upstream before storage.
